caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a geometric pattern composed of fabric pieces in red, blue, beige, and off-white. The main body of the quilt consists of four large beige diamond shapes set on a background of off-white fabric arranged in a grid. These diamonds are bordered and intersected by horizontal and vertical strips of red fabric with a white floral or abstract pattern, forming a cross shape at the center. The outer border along the top and sides appears in a blue fabric adorned with white dots, with two sections at the top corners made from red fabric with a wavy or marbled pattern. The quilt's edges are slightly frayed, indicating wear or age. The composition is centered on a plain, beige background, and the overall appearance of the fabrics suggests a patchwork or appliqué technique.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
